# Hermes Proactive Agent (`proactive-agent`)

> Hermes Agent plugin that runs the chat agent like a secretary that manages subagents: a turn time budget and background detach for the main agent, a handoff check for delegate_task (the user's recent messages and memory attached), a step budget and fail-fast for subagents, result notes and progress lines.

## Overview

- Repository: https://github.com/JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
- Target: Hermes Agent (tested with v0.22.7)
- Language: Python 3.10+
- License: MIT
- Version: 0.1.10

Roles:
- Main agent ("secretary"): keeps the chat responsive, investigates and decides, writes the handoffs.
- Subagents ("workers"): do the slow execution.

## Design

One simple step per stage of a task: turn budget (secretary) -> handoff (delegate_task) -> worker limits (subagent) -> results and progress (back to the secretary). Safety checks Hermes already does (denying subagents' dangerous commands, refusing stale file overwrites) are left to Hermes. No extra model calls are made.

## Capabilities

### Turn budget
- From 60 s in one turn: a one-time reminder to answer or delegate within 1-2 steps.
- From 120 s: editing and execution tools pause; read-only tools and delegate_task remain.
- A mid-turn user message (steer) resets the budget.
- Foreground terminal commands longer than 30 s move to the background via Hermes' yield path and notify on completion.
- process_manage(action='wait') is refused.

### Handoff (delegate_task)
- context under 120 characters is returned once per turn with a checklist.
- Accepted tasks get the user's recent messages verbatim, USER.md and MEMORY.md, working rules, and a default output_schema (status, summary, evidence, blockers).

### Worker limits
- Same call with the same result: a note after 3 repeats, a stop after 5 (the worker must report "blocked"; the user gets an alert).
- Step budget: 60 tool rounds (note at 80%).

### Results and progress
- When a worker returns, the secretary's next turn notes the reported evidence, missing evidence, an unfinished task or a plugin stop.
- Running workers are listed each turn.
- Progress lines every 5 minutes via ctx.post_message.

Only platforms in governed_platforms (default ["weixin"]) are affected. Cron runs and subagents of ungoverned sessions are untouched.

## Configuration

Keys under plugins.entries.proactive-agent.settings (environment override: PROACTIVE_<KEY>):

| Key | Default |
|---|---|
| governed_platforms | ["weixin"] |
| terminal_auto_detach_seconds | 30 |
| turn_soft_seconds | 60 |
| turn_hard_seconds | 120 |
| handoff_min_context_chars | 120 |
| handoff_memory_max_chars | 4000 |
| worker_max_tool_rounds | 60 |
| worker_repeat_limit | 5 |
| progress_interval_seconds | 300 |

## Install

```bash
hermes plugins install github:JerryLiu369/hermes-proactive-agent
hermes plugins enable proactive-agent
```
